notes.title: Version 1.02
notes.content:
Sorry about another update so soon, but this one is esential.

Version 1.02

[b]Balance[/b]

[list][*]Tweaked all the magical formulas to ensure lower magical damage from both heroes and enemies[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.01
notes.content:
[b]Bugfix[/b]

[list][*]The Weapon&Armor shop first opened an empty store, before prompting player to choose what to buy, this has been fixed.
[*]Using the spell of Quantum Leap didn't leave behind return teleport, this has been fixed
[*]Daggers above Iron Dagger had a wrong typing, causing them unable to be equiped, this has been fixed[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]

[list][*]Tweaked the speed of battles to make them faster[/list]
